evidence.quote: Founded in 2005 and based in Aix-en-Provence (France), SuperSonic Imagine is the world leader in diagnostic medical ultrasound technology. || Our teams in France and Germany provide tailored service and support to our customers and partners. || across a spectrum of medical specialties including radiology, hepatology, sports medicine, urology, pediatrics, vascular, obstetrics, gynecology, cardiac, and research applications
